whyItMatters: Detects writes to S3 objects (PutObject) which, when targeting public or website-enabled buckets, can indicate External Defacement (T1491.002) of static content. Aligned to MITRE ATT&CK analytics AN0666 and AN1625 (PutObject). REQUIRES S3 DATA-EVENT LOGGING: PutObject is an S3 data-plane event and is NOT recorded by default CloudTrail management-event logging (the standard SOF-ELK ingest). Website-configuration defacement (PutBucketWebsite) is a management event covered by aws_s3_data_management_tampering.yml. HIGH VOLUME: correlate with public-bucket / website context.
